svg.title: Known-best packing of 108 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=108 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Exact rational corners derived from retained SQUISH center/half-angle facts, checked with exact predicates at the source's exact rational side. The SVG rounds only for visualization. Verifies this upper-bound construction, not optimality or confirmation of the imported result in the frontier register. The source publishes no licence, so only derived geometry and attributed metadata are retained; this conservative retention policy is not a legal conclusion.

svg.text: U n=108 known best: side ~ 10.92065894 (certified upper bound)
